observations: Photos 0 and 1: a large floor-standing industrial bookbinding machine with a teal frame and cream side covers, standing in a workshop or warehouse.

Photo 0: front view shows an inclined brown metal feed saddle with a sensor at its tip, and above it a row of needle and hook units under a clear plastic guard: the layout of a thread book sewing machine.
Photo 1: side view shows a control panel with push buttons, a red and yellow rotary main switch, a second small control box, two handwheels and a long delivery arm to the right.
Photos 0 and 1: no maker's name, model plate or serial plate is readable; a small label on the cabinet in photo 1 is too small to read.
Photos 0 and 1: paint is worn and dirty in places, the feed saddle is rusty brown, but no part looks broken or missing from these angles.
No photo shows the machine powered on, running or sewing; no cables, threads or needles in use are shown.
Both photos carry a 'Posted on Jiji' watermark and a dealer name.

identity.kind: industrial book sewing machine (thread sewing for bookbinding)
read_from: photo 0 feed saddle and needle row
photo 1 control panel, handwheels and delivery arm

claims.evidence: No clip of the machine powered on, cycling or sewing a book block.

risks.risk: Machine may not run, may have electrical faults, a failed motor or worn needle and hook timing.
risks.proof: A clip with sound of the machine switched on and sewing several signatures into a book block, then a close-up of the sewn spine.

risks.risk: Maker and model unknown; an old or obscure make is worth far less than a known one.
risks.proof: A close photo of the maker's plate showing brand, model, serial and year.
risks.if_unproven: as the lowest value make of book sewing machine

risks.risk: Needles, hooks, thread guides or spare parts may be missing or worn.
risks.proof: Close photos of the needle bar and hook row from the front with the guard lifted.
risks.if_unproven: as missing needles and sewing parts

risks.risk: Machine may need three-phase power or the electrical panel may be damaged.
risks.proof: A photo of the electrical cabinet opened and the motor plate.

risks.risk: Photos may not be of the unit being sold.
risks.proof: A photo of the machine with a handwritten note carrying today's date and a code we give.
risks.if_unproven: identity confirmed at inspection before money moves

proof_requests: Close photo of the maker's plate with brand, model, serial and year.
Clip with sound of the machine running and sewing signatures into a book block.
Close photos of the needle and hook row with the guard lifted.
Photo of the electrical cabinet and motor plate.
Photo of the machine with a handwritten code and today's date.
response.reason: The feed saddle, needle row and delivery arm in photos 0 and 1 show an industrial book sewing machine, so it is priced by type at its worst case: unknown make and not working. The maker's plate and a running clip would raise it.
